The '''"Nullifier" Energy Diffusion Armor''' was a set of unique [[Armor/Legends|armor]] owned by [[Vallikor En-Vahdi]]. It was an ancient suit of [[Power armor/Legends|powered armor]] with black carapace plates covering the upper torso, a full-cover [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]], and tactile [[Glove/Legends|gloves]].<ref name="WHSV" />
